messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Wildlife Insights
parts:
It depends which function of  camtrapR you wish to use. 
The wildlife insights tables are fundamentally compatible, but may need a little processing since some data storage choices are different in Wildlife Insights.

I also have an function which reads wildlife insights tables to camtrapR, but it is not currently publicly available. I'll try to include it in camtrapR some time soon. 

Will let you know here when it's available.
